name: Merchant (Vargr)
description: Vargr merchants are the leaders of their own commercial enterprises or employees of larger corporations. The most common merchant professions are junk dealers, scroungers and contingency experts.

junk_dealer.name: Junk Dealer
junk_dealer.description: You are a second-hand equipment merchant who buys unwanted equipment from failed businesses or acquires it through salvage.

scrounger.name: Scrounger
scrounger.description: You are a broker or contingency expert able to find the best goods at the cheapest prices.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: A war or local hostilities block trade routes, putting you out of business. Roll END 8+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.3: You, or a member of your business pack, were involved in illegal activities. Your business is closed and you lose SOC −1.
mishaps.4: A rival company puts you out of business. You keep your Benefit roll for this term but gain the rival merchant as a Rival.
mishaps.5: One of your employees attempts to take leadership of the pack. Roll SOC 8+. If you fail, you lose your business and gain an Enemy. If you succeed, you may continue in this career and gain a Rival.
mishaps.6: The economic climate hits you hard forcing you into bankruptcy. Your business fails and you lose all Benefit rolls for this term.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You are approached by someone to buy or smuggle illegal goods for them. If you accept, roll Deception 8+ to gain a Benefit roll with DM+1. If you fail, you are arrested and lose SOC −1. If you refuse the deal, you gain an Enemy.
events.4: You find a bargain. Gain DM+1 to any Benefit roll for this career.
events.5: You enrol on a training course to further your knowledge. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.6: Your business is suspected of illegal activities but your own efforts prove your innocence. Gain one of Advocate 1, Admin 1, Diplomat 1, Investigate 1 or Persuade 1.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: You negotiate a lucrative business deal. Gain one Benefit roll.
events.9: You do a lot of business with one company, preventing them from going out of business. Gain an Ally.
events.10: You establish a network of business contacts. Gain a number of Contacts equal to your SOC modifier (minimum 1).
events.11: You do business with an influential corporation or organisation. Gain SOC +1 and DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: Your business thrives. You are automatically promoted and gain SOC +1.
